title: A document of a kinds file under .kit/kinds/
description: One kind of file, which a rule or a style names under kind: in its frontmatter. A kinds file holds one such document per kind, separated by --- lines. A path is of every kind whose glob or pattern matches it. Each key is described in docs/context.md.

name.description: The kind's name, which rules and styles name under kind:. The file's own name plays no part, and no two kinds share a name.

items.description: A glob matched against the repository-relative path; ** matches any depth.
An extended regular expression matched against the first line of a file that exists.
A kind whose text appears inside this kind's files, so kit context names its rules too and kit lint leaves them out.
A kind this kind is made of: a path of that kind is of this kind too.
